Aric of Dacia was a Visigoth warrior from the fifth century who was captured and enslaved by an alien race known as the Vine. blocks.x: Batman’s mantle has been taken up by various other heroes, and among them is Terry McGinnis, who dons a sleek, futuristic Batsuit designed by Bruce Wayne himself, effectively becoming the Dark Knight’s successor. He begins his story as a troubled teen who breaks into Wayne Manor and steals a high-tech Batsuit to avenge his father, who was unjustly murdered. Despite his tragic origin, Terry becomes a capable hero.

The Batsuit he inherits is built with synthetic muscle fibers and powered systems to amplify Terry’s strength and agility. Paired with retractable wings and boot thrusters, he can comfortably fly above the city, and with active cloaking, he is difficult to detect. https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/steel-john-henry-irons.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1

blocks.x: John Henry Irons built Steel’s identity around the powerful conviction that technology should protect people, not endanger them. As a gifted engineer and former weapons designer, Irons abandoned the arms industry after witnessing the devastation his inventions could cause. When Superman fell in battle against Doomsday, he created a mechanized suit to defend Metropolis in his place, honoring his legacy while building his own.

Steel uses powered armor to grant himself enhanced strength, flight, and protection against attacks. His most recognizable weapon is a massive steel sledgehammer, which was inspired by the folk hero John Henry and designed for maximum impact. Depending on the version of the story, his armor also has specialized weaponry and defense systems that aid his mission to protect the innocent.
